Nina K.: Quick ping - cert-rotator is failing for eu-central, hitting KMS quota errors intermittently during mass rotate. Logs: `ERROR cert-rotator: kms: rateLimitExceeded decrypt attempts=1200 window=60s`
Tom H.: That rotator job is scheduled at 03:00 UTC daily. We recently expanded it to include edge and internal certs in the same run. That may have created a KMS burst.
Eli G.: We should shard rotations across regions and add exponential backoff/retry with jitter. Also consider using locally cached KEKs to avoid KMS decrypt per cert during rotation.
Nina K.: Temporary mitigation: pause cert-rotator for eu-central and retry with staggered jobs. Pausing now. Command: `kubectl -n infra scale job/cert-rotator-eu-central --replicas=0`
security-bot: alert 3795551111: KMS_RATE_LIMIT spike during cert rotation. Ticket created: SEC-2026-221
Tom H.: Long term: 1) rotation pipeline should use a rotation coordinator that serializes small batches per region, 2) implement client-side KMS quota monitoring to throttle rotator, 3) pre-warm KEKs by caching unwraps in secure cache (rotate TTL 1h).
Eli G.: Also add dashboards: kms.decryption.latency, kms.decryption.errors by region, and alert on >500 errors in 5m.
Nina K.: I'll schedule an emergency change to shard today's rotation and add the cache. Will follow up with RFC.
security-bot: incident SEC-2026-221 opened and assigned to eng-security and eng-infra.
Nina K.: Thanks all. Paused and will update when safe to resume.
